name: Ouma ga Toki - Tasogare ni Kemuru Shoujo
original_name: 逢魔ガ刻 黄昏ニ烟ル少女
source:
Seemingly ordinary schoolgirl Yuki Mizuhara.
She has the power to see what nobody else can.
Things that make it hard for her to participate in normal society.
One day, her fate takes a dramatic turn. The things she sees...
The dark world beneath our own, full of terrors and secrets...
She learns the truth about it all. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100922.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
看似普通的女学生水原由纪。
她有能力看到别人看不到的东西。
使她难以参与正常社会的事情。
有一天，她的命运发生了戏剧性的转变。她所看到的东西……
我们脚下的黑暗世界，充满了恐怖和秘密……
她得知了这一切的真相。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100922.html]DLsite English[/url]]
